title: Settings API host descriptor
description: One host of a settings API, installed at <datadir>/phosphor-works/<api>-hosts/<id>.json and read by PhosphorConfig::HostDirectory, which checks the same rules at run time.

ConfigPath.description: The settings file, starting with one of the listed variables. A .. segment is refused at run time.

Desktops.description: XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP entries the host serves, compared ignoring case.
